logs.text: I have been diagnosed with depression.

scenarios.Title: Your Worst Nightmare
scenarios.Body:
You see an advertisement for a haunted house that promises to make you pass out. You excitedly text your friend and the two of you meet at the attraction. Outside, he asks what will terrify you the most if you encounter it inside.

What will you say?

logs.text: Before going into a haunted house on Halloween, I told my friend that tight spaces would terrify me the most if we encountered them inside the house.
I got a bad fever of 102.9 degrees.

scenarios.Title: Fever
scenarios.Body:
You're buried under a pile of blankets sweating but feel cold at the same time. To further complicate things, you have already dry-heaved multiple times today.

What will you do?

logs.text:
I had a fever that made me so cold I I buried myself under blankets trying to get warm.
I didn't let it bother me.
I have a new supervisor named Precious Pitt.

scenarios.Title: Difficulty Urinating
scenarios.Body:
You feel like you have to pee but when you try to use the toilet you can't go.

What will you do?

logs.text: I sat on the toilet forever trying to pee but nothing came out.

scenarios.Title: Doctor
scenarios.Body: Which local doctor will you schedule an appointment to see?

logs.text: I made a doctor's appointment.

scenarios.Title: Diagnosis
scenarios.Body:
Dr. Seaman has diagnosed you with kidney stones.

You continue to suffer from hay fever.

Select a treatment today!

logs.text: Dr. Seaman diagnosed me with kidney stones.

Dr. Seaman treated my kidney stones.
I continue to suffer from kidney stones.

scenarios.Title: Hope it worked
scenarios.Body: Dr. Seaman administered treatment to you for kidney stones.

scenarios.Title: Treat me right
scenarios.Body: You continue to suffer from kidney stones.

scenarios.Title: Casino
scenarios.Body:
Some of your friends are going to a local casino called Rosebud Casino Resort.

Will you join them?
_choices: No, I don't feel like it

logs.text: I went with some friends to Rosebud Casino Resort.

scenarios.Title: Golden Neko Statue
scenarios.Body:
Just as you're leaving the casino, you see a little old lady counting the biggest pile of coins you've ever seen.

She tells you that ever since she bought a Golden Neko Statue, her casino winnings have increased by 20%.

What will you do?

logs.text: I considered purchasing a Golden Neko Statue to increase my casino winnings.
So I guess this is what it feels like to be down in the dumps.

scenarios.Title: Termination
scenarios.Body:
You have been let go from your position as Housekeeper for The Clarkson Group.

They tell you it's because you danced too promiscuously at the holiday party.

logs.text:
I was let go from my job as Housekeeper for The Clarkson Group.
I called my supervisor a chode mongrel on my way out.

scenarios.Title: Stay classy
scenarios.Body: You called your supervisor a chode mongrel on your way out!

logs.text: I decided to start taking as many coins as possible while cleaning houses.
I have a new supervisor named Arleen Scrooge.

I was fired from my job as Housekeeper for Garcia Media.
I called my supervisor a mistake on my way out.
I had bloodshot eyes.

I did some research online and concluded that I have yellow fever.
I prayed that I would feel better.

A friend of my friend offered to set me up with a job as Palm Reader for Capital Psychic Hotline.
I was hired for the position of Palm Reader for Capital Psychic Hotline with a salary of $16,656.
